<USER_REQUEST>
Work on the SavorSpot project (Theme #19, Obsidian & Espresso dark luxury theme with deep charcoal/espresso backgrounds `#0a0807` / `#120e0c` / `#191310`, warm gold/champagne accents `#d4af37` / `#e7c68e`, `Cormorant Garamond` and `Plus Jakarta Sans` via Google Fonts, F-6 Markaz, Islamabad) on branch `i263231`.

Build the Culinary & Ambiance Gallery page (`pages/gallery.html`) along with `css/gallery.css` and `js/gallery.js`, integrated with shared navigation and `"savorCart"` cart drawer:

1. Semantic HTML5 (`pages/gallery.html`):
   - Use `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<section>`, `<article>`, and `<footer>` properly.
   - Keep consistent navigation links (`../index.html`, `pages/menu.html`, `pages/deals.html`, `pages/reservations.html`, `pages/about.html`, `pages/contact.html`, `gallery.html`, `chefs-reviews.html`, `catering.html`), live cart badge, `#savorCart` drawer (`localStorage` `"savorCart"`), and footer.
   - Include a gallery hero/header, category filter tabs (All, Signature Plates, Dining Ambiance, Bar & Beverages, Desserts), responsive photo/visual cards with captions, and a clean lightbox/preview modal or detail view.

2. Styling (`css/gallery.css`):
   - Match the Obsidian & Espresso dark luxury palette with gold/champagne accents, responsive gallery grid across desktop/tablet/mobile, active filter states, modal/lightbox styling, and drawer/toast styles.

3. Interactivity (`js/gallery.js`):
   - Filter gallery items live by category, open/close an accessible preview modal with next/previous navigation, and keep `"savorCart"` drawer/badge/toast synced.

4. Quality & Verification:
   - Zero lorem ipsum, clean relative paths from `pages/gallery.html`, valid HTML/CSS/JS syntax, and verify DOM IDs and asset paths.

After finishing, summarize all files created or updated, and remind to export `docs/ai-logs/i263231/session-01.md`.
</USER_REQUEST>
